config_source: kernel/config is the kernel source's own resolved configuration: make ARCH=arm64 LLVM=1 aurora_defconfig (arch/arm64/configs/aurora-base.config with asahi.config merged over it) at config_upstream.kernel_commit. The build regenerates it from the pinned source and fails if it differs; NixOS merges nothing over it except an owner's boot.kernelPatches settings, and checks kernel/nixos.config against it. Refresh the snapshot whenever the kernel pin changes.
